title: QA Pilot MCP Handler Registration
description: Schema defining QA Pilot-owned local MCP handler stubs. Handlers wrap the receipt store and enforce advisory/read-only authority. Cross-project registration is explicitly rejected.

project_boundary.description: Handlers must remain within the QA Pilot project boundary. Must not cross into The Librarian runtime.

store_integration.description: Handlers must call the QA Pilot receipt store only. Must not call The Librarian runtime.

cross_project_registration.description: Cross-project registration into The Librarian runtime is explicitly forbidden without a separate custody packet.
